question: Size the corporate-DAF segment across sponsors that do not publish it: read Tides Foundation, CAF America, Rockefeller Philanthropy Advisors, National Philanthropic Trust and the 10 largest community foundations (CY2021-2025 990 Schedule O, audited statements, annual reports) for any corporate vs individual split of DAF counts, contributions, grants and fees, in the same columns as SA01-SA05

question: Test whether the 2026 corporate 1% deduction floor (OBBBA s.70426) pulled corporate DAF contributions into 2025: compare FY2025 and FY2026 10-K/10-Q charitable and DAF contribution lines (start with Urban Outfitters $46.0m FY2026, Apollo $200m 2025, Zoom $20.9m FY2026, Circle $23.1m 2025) and Fidelity Charitable 2026 corporate figures when published
conclusion_affected: Whether corporate DAF inflows are a one-off 2025 bunching or a trend; timing of an entrant corporate product
